lines.en: I cross the grass on four legs
My plates catch the light
My tail steadies each turn
My stride stays even
My mane moves in the wind
I cross a clearing
My claws grip the soil
I go down a bank
My shadow lies long on the ground
I slowly pick up the pace
I make a turn about a tree
I lower my head a little
I dip my head under a branch
My plates dim in the shade
I stand still and my plates ring softly
I listen to both sides of the wood

lines.zh: 我在等脚下的电流静下来
lines.en: I wait for the current under my feet to settle.
I bury my nose in the grass
My tail sweeps lightly

lines.zh: 我把鬃毛抖开，甲片轻响
lines.en: I shake out my mane; my plates click.
I keep near my anchor
I have not wandered far

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上按了按
lines.en: I press a claw to the ground
I shake the plates on my back

lines.zh: 我的鼻息里带着电流声
lines.en: A faint crackle rides on my breath.
I wait for a tug on the reins.

lines.zh: 我把背上的甲片蹭了蹭
lines.en: I rub the plates along my back.
I lean my head into the wind
I angle my head to see you
You reach out; I sniff your hand first.

lines.zh: 我认得你手上的鞍带味
lines.en: I know the smell of saddle straps on your hands.
Did you bring the saddle
I lower my head for your hand
The wind parts my mane
I turn my head away and bare my neck.
I wait for you to say we go

lines.zh: 我的甲片在你眼前发亮
lines.en: My plates shine before you
You step back and hold
I lean a little your way
My eye glow leaks between plates

lines.zh: 我低头，鼻息喷在你脸上
lines.en: I lower my head and breathe on your face.
You have a tamer's scent
I press a forefoot down

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了一下又暗
lines.en: My eyes flare once and dim again.
I give ground and brace
A mark joins my plates
I let out a low call

lines.zh: 我的腿弯了一下才站住
lines.en: My legs buckle once before I hold.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我把电流蓄进獠牙。
lines.en: I gather a charge into my fangs after that blow.
I shake off the daze
My mane is mussed
I shift my weight back onto my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我的关节还能使得上劲
lines.en: My joints can still put out the strength.
You did hurt me
You have some scrap there
I sniff it, it is edible
I finish it in one bite
Is there more in your pocket
One gulp and it's gone. I want more.
Throw the scrap a little further
I lower my head to nudge it
I rather like this
My nose follows your hand
Give me one more piece
I take up the scrap

lines.zh: 我的鼻子追着你的口袋
lines.en: My nose follows your pocket.
You run into the plates along my flank.
My claws dig in and I hold steady.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲把你顶了回去
lines.en: My shoulder plate shoves you back.

lines.zh: 我的甲片把你硌了一下
lines.en: My plates gave you a hard knock.
I look at your reddened hand
I move my foot aside
I remember that impact
I only turn my ears.
You push me with both hands
Not a mark on my shoulder plate

lines.zh: 林子里还有别的数码兽
lines.en: There are other digimon in these woods

lines.zh: 我闻到一只成熟期的味道
lines.en: I smell a mature one nearby

lines.zh: 我们各自守自己的锚点
lines.en: We keep our own anchors
I have not thought of it
My tamer has not spoken
I stay on at the treeline
I answer into the trees
And I go back to grazing
I do not mean to leave my anchor
My ears twitch twice

lines.zh: 我把它衔在嘴里带回去
lines.en: I carry it back in my mouth.
I sniff it and turn my head away.
I nudge it to your boots

lines.zh: 我吐出来，用爪子拨了拨
lines.en: I spit it out and paw at it.
This could mend a saddle
I nudge it toward you with my nose.
I tuck it into the saddlebag.
I lower my head for scrap again
I pin it under a foot and wait for you.
I pick it up and my teeth knock on it.
Something has come near the woods

lines.zh: 我的鼻尖指向那边的动静
lines.en: My snout points toward that sound.
My mane rises a little
I shift my weight forward
My mouth opens a little
Two steps of mine and the ground thuds dully.
I swing my body across the path.

lines.zh: 这一带有不该来的味道
lines.en: Something here does not belong
I coil my body
I am about to call out

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转向那道声音
lines.en: My ears swivel toward that sound.
Stay still; I'll deal with it.
I close the gap steadily
My head drops to shoulder height
You go left, I block left
I follow that scent
I wait for you to reach the open
My plates begin to glow
I soften my steps and circle around.
Light gathers in my mouth
I know this stretch of path
I move to your rear flank
My pace has not slackened

lines.zh: 我顺着你喘息声追过去
lines.en: I follow the sound of your panting.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿磕在你的护肩上
lines.en: My teeth clang against your shoulder guard.
I ram you head on
My foreclaw swipes at you
I batter you with my brow horn
I toss you with a neck swing
I bear you down
My tail cuts low at your legs
You are knocked back several steps
I bite from a new angle
That carried my whole weight
I raise a forefoot over you

lines.zh: 我扑空，爪子刨起一层土
lines.en: I miss and my claws tear up the soil.
Plate light flares at the treeline
Lightning spreads out across my plates.
The ground shudders as I land

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛先出现在树后
lines.en: My mane shows past the trees
I raise my head to the woods
My four feet find the ground
An answer comes from the woods
My plates light one by one
I settle a few paces off
I raise my head to you
The wind lifts my mane
I wait here for a tamer
I shake out my mane
I pack the earth under my feet
Fire heats my plates
I land and my legs fold
Water plugs my nostrils
The blast knocks me sideways
An arrowhead jams my plate seam

lines.zh: 咒光让我的甲片一阵麻
lines.en: Magic numbs my plates
No scrap left, and I feel hollow

lines.zh: 雷电绕着我全身的甲走
lines.en: Lightning runs around all my plates
I claw at nothing as I fall
